title: What's New in v2.9.62
notes: ⚖️ Draw / Tie Support in Alliance Championship: AC match cards across the main war room, Vault archive viewer, and Admin match editor now support and display Draw outcomes (⚖️ DRAW).
📊 Dynamic Record Calculation: Tournament records automatically calculate wins, losses, and draws (e.g. 3 Wins – 1 Loss – 1 Draw).
🏛️ All-Time Dynasty Leaderboard Sync: Leaderboard dynasty statistics and quick stat cards now seamlessly track and display all-time draws alongside wins and losses.
